title: The Library Under the Owl
synopsis: The work has stopped. A ladder goes down under the owl square.
Livia has one last Owl game: seven gold letter tiles to find.
What has Rome kept under its streets for so long?
goal: Go down into the old room, find Livia's seven gold tiles, and spell what the map gave back to Rome.

options.label: Hold the rope with both hands

notes: Letter: the inspector's safety card (First, Next, Then, Last). Livia's game: the first two gold tiles, H and I, are by the ladder.

clueInputs.note: Valli's plan is known and the work has stopped.
The concrete of the city plan never came.

learning.objective: First, Next, Then, Last를 읽고 지하로 내려가는 안전 순서를 놓는다.
expressions: Then, go down the ladder slowly.

play.title: Safety First
story: The machines are quiet. In the middle of the square is a hole with a ladder.
The inspector hands you a card. "Nobody goes down without reading this."
play.letter:
GOING DOWN SAFELY
Last, turn on your lamp at the bottom.
First, put on a helmet.
Next, hold the rope with both hands.
Then, go down the ladder slowly.
play.question: Put the safety steps in order.
hints: Next comes before Then on this card.
play.successMessage: You are ready to go down!
transition: On the top step of the ladder, two gold tiles shine: Y and T.
You go down, slowly. Then you turn on your lamp.
play.orderFeedback: Read First, Next, Then and Last again.

clue.title: Gold Tiles by the Ladder
clue.note: Two of Livia's gold tiles were on the ladder: Y and T.

evidence.name: The Safety Card
evidence.description: The inspector's card for going down under the square.

lines.text: I hid seven gold letter tiles today.
Find them all, and spell my last word.

discovery.title: TWO GOLD TILES: Y AND T
discovery.detail: Five more tiles are hidden down below. Go down slowly!

options.label: Bottles of olive oil
options.feedback: Read Aldo's card. What did the Romans keep in square holes?

options.label: Pools of water
options.feedback: Pools are for baths, and they are in the floor, not in the walls.

notes: Recall: the real piece (Case 11), to match the room. Letter: Aldo's card on Roman libraries. Two more gold tiles: S and T.

clueInputs.note: The real piece shows this room.
Aldo's Latin card: Roman books were scrolls in square holes.

learning.objective: 옛 도서관 설명(scrolls, square holes)을 읽고 벽의 구멍에 무엇을 보관했는지 고른다.
expressions: They were scrolls: long pages, rolled up.
Scrolls were kept in square holes in the walls.

play.title: Holes in the Walls
story: Your lamp shines on old walls full of small square holes.
play.letter:
IN A ROMAN LIBRARY
Books were not like our books.
They were scrolls: long pages, rolled up.
Scrolls were kept in square holes in the walls.
Roman baths had pools of water, not holes in the walls.
play.question: What did the Romans keep in these square holes?
hints: This room is a library. What did Roman books look like?
Find the line about square holes on Aldo's card.
transition: Each square hole once held scrolls.
In one hole, you find two gold tiles: H and O.
Livia points to the floor. "Look at the middle of the room."

clue.title: The Scroll Holes
clue.note: Two gold tiles were in a scroll hole: H and O.

evidence.name: Aldo's Library Card
evidence.inscription: Scrolls were kept in square holes in the walls.

recall.title: Is this the room?
recall.prompt: Which thing in your Notebook shows this room on the old map?
recall.miss: Find the real map piece from Valli's box room.

talk.speaker: aldo_rinaldi
talk.goal: Find out what the holes were for.

lines.text: It is real. It is all real!
Remember my Latin card? Read this one.

discovery.title: SCROLLS IN THE WALLS
discovery.detail: This was a real Roman library. And two more tiles were waiting.

notes: Letter: the owl mosaic's Latin word SAPIENTIA and Aldo's word box (wisdom, wealth, weather). Three more gold tiles: O, R, Y.

clueInputs.note: Valli wanted money: wealth, not wisdom.

learning.objective: 뜻풀이 목록에서 SAPIENTIA의 뜻(knowing a lot and making good choices)에 맞는 단어 wisdom을 쓴다.
expressions: WISDOM — knowing a lot and making good choices.
The Romans said the owl was the bird of SAPIENTIA.

play.title: The Owl in the Floor
story: In the middle of the floor is an owl made of tiny stone tiles.
Around it are Latin letters: SAPIENTIA.
play.letter:
SAPIENTIA is a Latin word.
It means knowing a lot and making good choices.
The Romans said the owl was the bird of SAPIENTIA.

WORD BOX:
WISDOM — knowing a lot and making good choices.
WEALTH — having a lot of money.
WEATHER — rain, sun and wind.
play.question: What does SAPIENTIA mean in English?
hints: Read what SAPIENTIA means on Aldo's card.
Find the word in the word box with the same meaning.
transition: Under the owl's eye, three gold tiles are waiting: S, I and R.
"That makes seven," says Giulia. "Let's go back to the museum."

feedback.WEALTH: Wealth is having a lot of money. That is what Signor Valli wanted. What did the owl mean?
feedback.WEATHER: Weather is rain, sun and wind. What means making good choices?

play.orderFeedback: Check your spelling in the word box.

clue.title: The Owl's Word
clue.note: Three gold tiles were under the owl's eye: S, I and R.

evidence.name: The Owl Mosaic
evidence.description: An owl made of tiny stone tiles, in the floor of the Roman library.

talk.speaker: livia_conti
talk.goal: Read the word around the owl.

lines.text: Now I know why I chose the owl.

discovery.title: SAPIENTIA MEANS WISDOM
discovery.detail: The Romans called the owl the bird of wisdom. Now you have all seven tiles.

notes: The season's letter-collecting final: the seven gold tiles found in this case's three missions spell HISTORY, 'the story of the past'.
STEP 3-14: the tiles are found Y T, H O, S I R and listed in that order, so the letter no longer spells the answer; the tile strip is shuffled the same way.

clueInputs.note: Gold tiles O, R and Y.
The real piece, back in its case.

learning.objective: 모은 금색 글자 일곱 개를 뜻풀이(the story of the past)에 맞게 배열해 history를 만든다.
expressions: It is the story of the past.

play.title: Seven Gold Tiles
story: The map hall is full of people.
The real piece is back in its glass case.
A new label says: "Found again, with help from Livia Conti."
Enzo, Pia, Carla and Aldo are all here. Livia gives you one last owl card, and a little lock with seven empty slots.
play.letter:
Dear Detective,
You found my seven gold tiles: Y, T, H, O, S, I, R.
Put them in order to spell what the old map gave back to Rome.
It is not money.
It is the story of the past.
— The Owl (Livia)
play.question: Spell the word with your seven gold tiles.
hints: The word means the story of the past.
It starts with the first tile you found in the scroll hole.
play.successMessage: The last lock opens. Everyone claps!
transition: The city will make Piazza della Civetta a small museum.
The old library below it will be open to everyone.
Bruno Valli must answer to the city for what he did.
Giulia smiles at you. "You found one more story, piece by piece."
play.orderFeedback: All seven tiles are right. Which word means the story of the past?

evidence.name: The Owl's Last Card
evidence.description: Livia's last owl card, given to you in the map hall.
evidence.inscription: It is not money. It is the story of the past.

play.evidenceLinkLine: The real piece from Valli's box room, back in its glass case.

ending.text: HISTORY. The story of the past.
ending.speaker: livia_conti

ending.text: The old map kept this story safe.
And now it is back where it belongs.
ending.speaker: sofia_ferri

ending.text: No more dark ten minutes in my hall!
ending.speaker: enzo_greco

ending.text: I will write a new chapter tonight!
ending.speaker: aldo_rinaldi

ending.text: Rome has more stories, Detective. Come back soon.
ending.speaker: giulia_marino

hook: The broken map of Rome is whole again. Where will your next case take you?

learningGoal.title: The story of the past: scrolls, wisdom, history

objectives: Find what the old library kept.
Spell the word of the seven gold tiles.
intro: This morning, the city opened a small hole in the middle of Piazza della Civetta.
Everyone wants to see what is under the owl square.
play.caseSummary: Under Piazza della Civetta, you found the old Roman library from the map. Its walls have square holes for scrolls. Its owl mosaic says SAPIENTIA: wisdom. Livia's seven gold tiles spelled HISTORY. The real piece is back in its glass case. The library will become a museum.

notes: The season's end: the core mystery resolved (story bible coreMystery.resolvedCase). The final is the season's letter-collecting final.
Its last scene is the map hall of Case 01: the season closes where it opened.
STEP 3-14: the gold tiles are found in a new order (Y T, H O, S I R) so the final's letter no longer spells HISTORY. Talks, Discovery Moments and a season ending with every helper added.
